sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000180-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Blue Ridge Medical Group 180 on December 15, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 4.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Pneumococcal share floor of 95%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: accepted by the Customer.
